name: Wand to Bethor
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed.  This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it.  So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.

Here.  Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past.  I'm sure he will want it.
narrative.objectives: Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
...what is this? Thule had our Woven Wand? I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!

He must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it. And it is good that he did not use it...

This is a marvelous find. You have my gratitude, adventurer, and will be rewarded.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer. Have you defeated Thule Ravenclaw?
